en.headline: Wild boar captured in Victoria Park after morning sighting
en.dek: Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department staff used a tranquiliser dart to remove the one-metre animal from the Causeway Bay park after police secured the area.
body: A wild boar about one metre long entered Victoria Park in Causeway Bay on Thursday morning, prompting police to respond with shields while the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department arranged its capture.

The animal was first reported around 7.17am near a snack kiosk and grassy areas, where it paced and sunbathed. Morning exercisers alerted police, who cordoned off parts of the park and followed the boar to prevent it from approaching people.

AFCD officers arrived later with nets and shields. After the boar was darted with a tranquiliser, it was loaded onto a vehicle and removed from the park around 11.30am, according to reports. The operation lasted more than three hours.

The department has previously warned against feeding wild animals, noting that such behaviour can reduce their fear of humans and increase risks. Illegal feeding of wild boars carries fixed penalties.

zh.headline: 維多利亞公園野豬出沒 漁護署施麻醉搶後運走
zh.dek: 今早約7時一頭約1米長野豬閱入銅鑼灣維園，警方持盾戒備，漁農自然護理署人員於上午用麻醉搶將其捕獲運走。
body: 今日上午約7時17分，一頭約1米長的野豬出現在銅鑼灣維多利亞公園，近小食亭草地來回躊步並日光浴。晨運客見狀報警。
警方到場持盾牌戒備，封鎖部分公園範圍，防止野豬接近市民。漁農自然護理署人員其後到場，使用圍網縮小活動範圍。
漁護署獸醫向野豬發射麻醉搶後，野豬晕倒，被抬上客貨車運走。整個行動持續超過三小時，約11時30分完成。
漁護署曾呼籲市民勿饋飼野生動物，以免改變其習性並增加公眾安全風險。非法饋飼野豬可被發定額罰款通知書。
